title: Move Papyrus catalog fields under metadata.papyrus and delete both compatibility shims
description:
## Goal
Delete both compatibility shims for the catalog by giving Papyrus extension data one home.

## Background
Papyrus writes top-level fields into `metadata/catalog.json` items (`identifiers`, `papyrus`, `summary`, `subtitle`, `title_subtitle_resolution`, and others listed in Papyrus `reference_curation_signals.py` `CATALOG_EXTENSION_ROOT_FIELDS`). Biblicus answered with `src/biblicus/catalog_compat.py`, which folds unknown fields into `metadata` on read. Papyrus answered with `_preflight_biblicus_catalog_compatibility` in `analysis_commands.py`, which rejects those same fields before graph extraction.

## Work
1. Biblicus: document `metadata.papyrus` as the extension location. Migration: a one-time command or script that moves existing top-level extension fields under `metadata`. Then delete `catalog_compat.py` and make strict `CatalogItem` validation the only path. No fallback.
2. Papyrus (repo AnthusAI/Papyrus): write extension fields under `metadata.papyrus`, delete `_preflight_biblicus_catalog_compatibility` and the `.biblicus/catalog.json` fallback in `reference_curation_signals.py`, and remove the legacy mixed-case corpus folder fallback in `analysis_commands.py`.
3. Migrate the Pilobol.us and Papyrus corpora.

Depends on blbs-def144 (Corpus path accessors).
